asks: Did you see which way they went?
Are you going to sit down or not?
How long have I been holding this for them?
description: A bench, quite ordinary, with a person-shaped warmth still in it and the wood still faintly bowed where the weight was. Whoever it was has only just stood up, and keeps having only just stood up.
emotes: {it} creaks, once, under a weight that is not on it.
{it} settles as though somebody has just got up.
{it} stays exactly as warm as it was.
looks: The seat is warm in one place and cold everywhere else, and the warm place does not fade.
The wood is worn to a shine in exactly one spot and untouched either side of it.
There is a shape in the dust on the floor where two feet were, and the dust has not filled it in.
name: a bench with somebody just gone from it
says: They will be back. They always come back.
Sit somewhere else, if you do not mind.
